items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Why did they take Lou Chudden and Art Rupp and... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, they were, quote, entrepreneurs.

ctx.x: I don't know. A couple of people tried little things.
Why did they take Lou Chudden and Art Rupp and...

Well, they were, quote, entrepreneurs. They... You see, if a guy down here would have recorded something, he wouldn't have been recording it because this was his chance to make a million dollars. He'd be recording because this guy he heard in a club was so good. I mean, this guy's got to get a break. I'm going to come up with some money and record him and hope...
